One thing off to the side that I'm flagging but not chasing here: `ops.py:1338` round-trips the result through `pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(ret))` whenever `TEST_PICKLE` is set — a `pickle.loads` on freshly re-serialized objects is the kind of pattern that deserves a careful look on its own (process relay ships these patternmatchers across the boundary, so the trust assumptions there matter). It's gated behind a debug env var and sits well outside the F2 mechanism we're verifying, so I'm leaving it untouched — noting it for a future pass, not editing it now.

Back to F2: let me confirm `deconstruct_function`'s harvest actually misses the depth-2 `AxisType` reference at runtime before I sign off on your mechanism.
